title: Amphitheatrvm Sapientiae Aeternae (Khunrath, 1653)
shelf_note: Khunrath's Amphitheatrum is a core Christian-Kabbalistic / alchemical work; the kabbalah shelf is right.
structure_note: Printed numbers on the pages are consecutive (10, 11, 12), so the 63 repeats and 6 backsteps probably come from plates and unnumbered leaves, or from misread numerals, not from a splice. structure_note: The colophon (page 39) gives Rabīʿ II 16, AH 1308 (late 1890); the catalogue says 'published 1306 [1889]', so one of them is wrong. Openings are pencil-foliated 32-34; page 37's OCR reads 52 for 32. Seven of 43 pages are untranslated.

title: Kriyakandakramavali (MS Add.1406)
shelf_note: Somaśambhu's Śaiva ritual manual, a Cambridge palm-leaf manuscript in Newar script. The shelf is right; the text served is not.
structure_note: Folio numerals ७४ and ७५ in the right margin (pages 149 and 151), with page 150 the unnumbered verso, so the image order is right. The 44 backsteps and 44 repeats fit recto/verso numbering. 'published: 1000' is the composition date (c. 1095 CE), not a manuscript date. The real problem is that the OCR is not of these leaves.

book_verdict: None of the three leaves is transcribed. Gemini served Purāṇic dialogue, a Navārṇa stotra it admits reconstructing from 'standard patterns', and a Devī Māhātmya battle in place of a Newar-script Śaiva ritual manual, and the translations render those fabrications faithfully. The text should be withheld and re-read in a lane that can read Newar script.
